intro.text: A group of islands in the Sapphire Sea.

description.text: Fort and Salay, who share the same ethnicity, both come from the islands.

The islands are known for a culture of hunters, whose creed is that each must seek a worthy hunt. Since a society made only of hunters could not thrive, the idea has widened over time: on coming of age, people pick a hunt that can be nearly anything, from baking fine bread to arranging weddings. Islanders abroad write home about their hunts, and the letters are recorded and put on display.
